issues.t: Engine stalls or won't restart from failed fuel pump control module
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving or at a stop and then cranks but won't start. Power steering can get heavy when it dies, and some owners couldn't shift into Neutral for a tow.
issues.why: The fuel pump control (driver) module that powers the fuel pump fails, so the pump stops running. Dealers often find code P203F or similar.
issues.next: Get safely off the road and call for a tow. Ask the dealer to check the fuel pump control module and whether any GM program covers your VIN.

issues.t: Rough, delayed or lurching shifts from the 9-speed automatic
issues.sym: Stuttering or jerky shifts, lurching when slowing to a stop, a delay when shifting into Drive or Reverse, or a sudden loss of power with a transmission warning.
issues.why: The 9-speed automatic's shift calibration and valve body cause harsh shifts. Some cars needed a valve body or a complete transmission.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check for software updates and stored transmission codes. If the car loses power or slips, have it towed in rather than driving it.

issues.t: Oil leak from the camshaft carrier seal
issues.sym: Oil found around the top of the engine during an oil change, a burning oil smell, or oil drips. Often there is no warning beforehand.
issues.why: A seal at the joint where the camshaft carrier meets the cylinder head leaks. Dealers have called it a fairly common XT4 problem, and the repair is labor-heavy.
issues.next: Watch the oil level between changes. Get a written estimate and ask Cadillac about goodwill help if the car is just past warranty.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking activates with nothing ahead
issues.sym: The car brakes hard on its own at highway speed, at a green light or when backing up, with no obstacle. Several owners were nearly hit from behind.
issues.why: The front camera-based collision system misreads the road and triggers false braking. GM bulletin 24-NA-053 covers false activations on these years.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 24-NA-053 and camera reprogramming. Until it's fixed, you can reduce the alert setting or turn automatic braking off in settings.

issues.t: LED daytime running light goes dim or out
issues.sym: One daytime running light, often the passenger side, dims or goes dark. One owner said the light melted, causing a failed inspection.
issues.why: Heat damages the LED circuit board inside the headlamp. GM bulletin 19-NA-184 covers it.
issues.next: Mention bulletin 19-NA-184 to the dealer. The fix is usually a new headlamp assembly.

issues.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
issues.sym: A rattle from the engine for a few seconds after a cold start, or an 'engine power reduced' message.
issues.why: The timing chain tensioner fails, letting the chain slap until oil pressure builds. GM has released a revised tensioner.
issues.next: Have it checked soon. A loose chain can jump a tooth and cause major engine damage.

issues.t: Coolant leak and overheating
issues.sym: Overheating warnings, the engine limiting RPM, stalling, or coolant loss.
issues.why: Owners report water pump failures and small coolant leaks. In one case a head gasket leak was later found.
issues.next: Stop driving if it overheats. Have the cooling system pressure-tested and ask about warranty coverage.

issues.t: Oil leak from the intake manifold gasket
issues.sym: Oil running down the passenger side of the engine, sometimes with stalling or rough running.
issues.why: The intake manifold gasket leaks oil. One owner needed three repair attempts.
issues.next: Have the source of the leak confirmed with dye. The gasket is a small part, but replacing it is a bigger job.

issues.t: Battery drains and car won't start
issues.sym: The car won't start or takes several tries, sometimes after the hazard lights stay on, with StabiliTrak or other warnings.
issues.why: Batteries go flat early, and some owners needed more than one battery in a few years. A module staying awake can drain it.
issues.next: Have the battery tested. If a new battery dies again, ask for a parasitic drain test.

issues.t: Front brakes squeal when backing up or on light stops
issues.sym: A squeal from the front brakes for the first few stops in the morning or when reversing, with plenty of pad left.
issues.why: The pad and rotor combination squeals. GM bulletin 20-NA-002 addresses it on 2020 models.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 20-NA-002. Anti-squeal lubricant or new pads usually help; you rarely need a full brake job.

issues.t: Instrument cluster and screens go dark
issues.sym: The digital gauges, radio and center screen black out for 30 seconds or longer while driving, taking the speedometer and fuel gauge with them.
issues.why: A fault in the radio or display module makes the screens reboot. Swapping the radio didn't always fix it.
issues.next: Note when it happens and ask the dealer to check for software updates and module codes.

issues.t: OnStar and emergency calling stop working
issues.sym: A 'Service Emergency Calling' message, with OnStar, navigation or apps not working. One owner said it drained the battery.
issues.why: The telematics control module fails. Owners report long backorders for replacement modules.
issues.next: Have the dealer check the telematics module under warranty. Keep a charged phone for emergencies until it's fixed.

issues.t: Leaking struts or noisy front strut mounts
issues.sym: Popping or clunking over bumps, oily residue on the shocks or struts, or a bouncy ride.
issues.why: Front struts and strut mounts wear early on some cars, and some shocks leak oil.
issues.next: Have the suspension inspected. Get an alignment after strut work.

issues.t: Check engine light from EVAP purge pump
issues.sym: Check engine light, often with code P0496, rough starting, or changing fuel economy.
issues.why: The evaporative emissions purge pump on the turbo engine fails or leaks.
issues.next: Have the code confirmed. It's not urgent, but the car will fail an emissions test.

issues.t: Transmission won't shift into 9th gear
issues.sym: The car stays in 8th on the highway unless you use the paddle shifters, and fuel economy drops.
issues.why: GM bulletin 21-NA-181 says the transmission skips 9th under some conditions by design; owners dispute it.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 21-NA-181 and any newer software.

issues.t: Sunroof glass shatters
issues.sym: A loud bang and broken glass in the sunroof panel with nothing hitting it.
issues.why: Owners report the sunroof glass breaking on its own.
issues.next: Close the shade, cover the opening and have the glass replaced. Ask the dealer to file a report with GM.

issues.t: Start/stop accumulator may be missing bolts (recall)
issues.sym: Transmission fluid spots under the car, or losing drive.
issues.why: The end cap on the 9-speed's start/stop accumulator may be missing bolts and leak fluid, which could also cause a fire near hot parts.
issues.next: Check for open recalls. The dealer inspects and replaces the accumulator for free.

issues.t: Rearview camera image drops out (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera screen goes blank or flickers when reversing on cars with Surround Vision.
issues.why: The video processing module can lose contact with the rear camera.
issues.next: The dealer updates or replaces the module for free. Some owners say the problem came back; return to the dealer if it does.

issues.t: Brake assist can be lost (recall)
issues.sym: A hard brake pedal that needs much more force, with brake warning messages.
issues.why: Contamination at a sensor connection in the electronic brake booster can interrupt communication and cut power assist.
issues.next: Get the free brake boost module replacement. Leave more stopping distance until then.

issues.t: Over-cured tires can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Bulges or cracks in the sidewall, or a tire losing air suddenly.
issues.why: Some original tires were over-cured at the factory and can break at the sidewall or separate.
issues.next: Check your tires' DOT codes or have the dealer inspect them; affected tires are replaced free.

issues.t: Rear seat belt retractor may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: A rattle from a rear seat belt retractor.
issues.why: Fasteners holding the rear belt retractors may be loose or missing.
issues.next: The dealer inspects and tightens them for free.

issues.t: Driver seat frame weld may be faulty (recall)
issues.sym: The driver's seat cushion may feel loose or shift.
issues.why: An improper weld in the power seat tilt mechanism may not hold the driver in a crash.
issues.next: The dealer inspects the seat and replaces the cushion frame if needed, for free.

issues.t: Passenger airbag cover may lack tear seam (recall)
issues.sym: No visible sign.
issues.why: The dashboard cover may be missing the hidden perforation that lets the passenger airbag deploy properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls. The dealer replaces the upper dash cover for free.

issues.t: Wrong owner's manual supplied (recall)
issues.sym: The printed manual in the glove box doesn't match your car.
issues.why: Some cars left the factory with the wrong owner's manual, which has incorrect safety information.
issues.next: The dealer will supply the correct manual for free.
